_comment: Small deterministic document corpus for the RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) lab. Real product facts drawn from this repository's own seeded QA-DEMO-SYSTEM data, so groundedness checks compare against a fact that is itself checkable.

documents.title: QA Demo Klavye
documents.text: QA Demo Klavye is a mechanical keyboard product in the QA Demo System catalog. It is seeded with stock_quantity 25 and price 1499.90 TRY.

documents.title: QA Demo Mouse
documents.text: QA Demo Mouse is a wireless mouse product in the QA Demo System catalog. It is seeded with stock_quantity 0, meaning it is out of stock.

documents.title: Selenium Lab
documents.text: The Selenium lab in this repository runs real Chrome automation in GitHub Actions CI and reports CLEANUP_FAILED when driver.quit() fails, even with an empty error message.

documents.title: Retry Pattern Status
documents.text: The Retry system pattern is documented but not implemented anywhere in this repository's backend or automation code, as verified by a repository-wide grep.
